runs.output:
Here’s a simple JavaScript function that returns a greeting based on a name and time of day:

```javascript
function greet(name, timeOfDay) {
  return `Good ${timeOfDay}, ${name}!`;
}
```

### Example:
```javascript
console.log(greet("Alice", "morning")); // Good morning, Alice!
console.log(greet("Bob", "evening"));   // Good evening, Bob!
```

If you want, I can also make it automatically choose `"morning"`, `"afternoon"`, or `"evening"` based on the current time.
